newsitem.title: UK: Norwich Union says flotation report is speculative.
newsitem.headline: Norwich Union says flotation report is speculative.

text.p: Norwich Union said on Monday that a newspaper report suggesting it would announce a stock market flotation within the next two weeks was speculative.

"It's a speculative piece. Our position remains unchanged and we will make an announcement before the end of the year," Hayley Stimpton, press relations manager for the UK mutual insurance company said of the report in The Times
Last October Norwich Union said it was considering demutualisation and flotation and would make an announcement on this before the end of 1996.

The Times reported the flotation, likely to be next June, would be worth around 4.0 billion stg and would result in share bonuses averaging 700 stg to each of the mutual company's three million with-profits policyholders.

Norwich Union's Stimpson would not comment on any of the details in the report, which also said the group would need to find a venue large enough to hold policyholders for an extraordinary general meeting in London next spring.
The position outlined by Norwich Union last year remained unchanged, she said.
